FROZEN_NOW = datetime(2023, 1, 20, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


@pytest.fixture
def event_schedule(event, user):
    return event.scheduled_exports.create(
        owner=user,
        export_identifier="orderlist",
        export_form_data={"_format": "xlsx"},
        locale="en",
        mail_subject="Order list",
        mail_template="Here is the order list",
        schedule_rrule="DTSTART:20230118T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1;WKST=MO",
        schedule_rrule_time=time(2, 30, 0),
    )


@pytest.fixture
def organizer_schedule(event, user):
    return event.organizer.scheduled_exports.create(
        owner=user,
        export_identifier="giftcardlist",
        export_form_data={"_format": "xlsx"},
        locale="en",
        mail_subject="Gift card list",
        mail_template="Here is the gift card list",
        schedule_rrule="DTSTART:20230118T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1;WKST=MO",
        schedule_rrule_time=time(2, 30, 0),
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_queues_due_event_export(event, event_schedule):
    with freeze_time(FROZEN_NOW):
        event_schedule.schedule_next_run = now() - timedelta(minutes=1)
        event_schedule.save()

        with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(None)

        apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'event': event.pk, 'schedule': event_schedule.pk})
        event_schedule.refresh_from_db()
        assert event_schedule.schedule_next_run > now()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_queues_due_organizer_export(event, organizer_schedule):
    with freeze_time(FROZEN_NOW):
        organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run = now() - timedelta(minutes=1)
        organizer_schedule.save()

        with mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(None)

        apply_async.assert_called_once_with(
            kwargs={'organizer': event.organizer.pk, 'schedule': organizer_schedule.pk}
        )
        organizer_schedule.refresh_from_db()
        assert organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run > now()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_skips_schedules_not_yet_due(event, event_schedule, organizer_schedule):
    with freeze_time(FROZEN_NOW):
        future = now() + timedelta(hours=1)
        event_schedule.schedule_next_run = future
        event_schedule.save()
        organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run = future
        organizer_schedule.save()

        with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as event_apply_async, \
                mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as organizer_apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(None)

        event_apply_async.assert_not_called()
        organizer_apply_async.assert_not_called()
        event_schedule.refresh_from_db()
        organizer_schedule.refresh_from_db()
        assert event_schedule.schedule_next_run == future
        assert organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run == future


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_skips_schedules_without_next_run(event, event_schedule, organizer_schedule):
    with freeze_time(FROZEN_NOW):
        assert event_schedule.schedule_next_run is None
        assert organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run is None

        with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as event_apply_async, \
                mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as organizer_apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(None)

        event_apply_async.assert_not_called()
        organizer_apply_async.assert_not_called()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_does_not_queue_same_schedule_twice(event, event_schedule, organizer_schedule):
    with freeze_time(FROZEN_NOW):
        event_schedule.schedule_next_run = now() - timedelta(minutes=1)
        event_schedule.save()
        organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run = now() - timedelta(minutes=1)
        organizer_schedule.save()

        with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as event_apply_async, \
                mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as organizer_apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(None)
            run_scheduled_exports(None)

        event_apply_async.assert_called_once()
        organizer_apply_async.assert_called_once()
EOF
